Actual reach, equipment storage and safe use require household-specific review.

operating_envelope.basis: Original generic geometry and concept standing allowance, not a selected product. Host must test actual movement, opposing fixtures and people/route space.

service_requirements: Resolve fixing strength, shelf/rail loads, chosen hardware and electrical supply where lighting is added.
Moving drawer/hamper envelope is separate from through-circulation; do not claim two people can pass while open.
